create-hierarchical-pdf-bookmarks.title: Create Hierarchical Bookmarks in a PDF
create-hierarchical-pdf-bookmarks.description: Shows how to bind a PDF with PdfBookmarkEditor, build a root bookmark with child chapter entries, and save the document with the new outline.

merge-pdf-bookmarks.title: Merge PDF Bookmarks from an External Document
merge-pdf-bookmarks.description: Shows how to import bookmark outlines from a source PDF and merge them into a target PDF while preserving hierarchy and order using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-bookmarks-to-csv.title: Export PDF Bookmarks to CSV
export-pdf-bookmarks-to-csv.description: Shows how to extract all bookmarks from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfBookmarkEditor and write each bookmark's title, destination, and hierarchy level to a CSV file.

update-bookmark-destination-to-page-10.title: Update Bookmark Destination to Page 10
update-bookmark-destination-to-page-10.description: Shows how to delete an existing PDF bookmark and create a new one that points to page 10 using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfBookmarkEditor.

delete-all-bookmarks-from-pdf.title: Delete All Bookmarks from PDF
delete-all-bookmarks-from-pdf.description: Shows how to remove every bookmark from a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfBookmarkEditor and save the cleaned file.

delete-bookmark-from-pdf.title: Delete a Single PDF Bookmark and Verify Removal
delete-bookmark-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to delete a specific bookmark from a PDF using the PdfBookmarkEditor facade, save the changes, and confirm the bookmark was removed by re‑extracting the bookmarks.

add-top-level-blue-bookmark-to-pdf.title: Add Top-Level Blue Bookmark to First Page
add-top-level-blue-bookmark-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a top-level bookmark that points to page 1 and sets its title color to blue using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-subbookmarks-to-pdf-chapter.title: Add Child Bookmarks Under an Existing Parent Bookmark
add-subbookmarks-to-pdf-chapter.description: Demonstrates how to locate an existing outline entry in a PDF and add child bookmarks that point to specific pages, then save the updated document.

extract-pdf-bookmarks-to-json.title: Export PDF Bookmarks to Nested JSON
extract-pdf-bookmarks-to-json.description: Shows how to extract the hierarchical bookmark structure from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and serialize it into a nested JSON file.

export-pdf-bookmarks-to-xml.title: Export PDF Bookmarks to XML
export-pdf-bookmarks-to-xml.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF document with PdfBookmarkEditor and export its complete bookmark hierarchy to an XML file for external documentation tools.

import-bookmarks-from-json.title: Import Bookmarks from JSON into a PDF
import-bookmarks-from-json.description: Shows how to read a JSON file, map its entries to Aspose.Pdf.Facades Bookmark objects, and add the hierarchical bookmarks to a PDF using PdfBookmarkEditor.

add-toc-bookmark-to-pdfs-batch.title: Batch Add Table of Contents Bookmark to PDFs
add-toc-bookmark-to-pdfs-batch.description: Shows how to loop through all PDF files in a folder and add a standard "Table of Contents" bookmark to each document using Aspose.Pdf's PdfBookmarkEditor.

validate-pdf-bookmark-count.title: Validate PDF Bookmark Count After Saving
validate-pdf-bookmark-count.description: Loads a PDF, saves it to a new file, extracts its bookmarks using PdfBookmarkEditor, and checks that the number of bookmarks matches the expected value.

update-pdf-bookmark-title.title: Add Bookmark to PDF Using MemoryStream
update-pdf-bookmark-title.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a byte array via MemoryStream, adding a top‑level bookmark, and returning the modified PDF as a byte array.

add-external-url-bookmarks-to-pdf.title: Add External URL Bookmarks to PDF
add-external-url-bookmarks-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create PDF bookmarks that open external web URLs using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-bookmark-titles-to-title-case.title: Update PDF Bookmark Titles to Title Case
convert-bookmark-titles-to-title-case.description: Loads a PDF, walks through its bookmark (outline) hierarchy, and converts each title to title case while preserving predefined proper nouns. The modified PDF is then saved.

delete-bookmarks-matching-regex.title: Delete Bookmarks Matching a Regex Pattern
delete-bookmarks-matching-regex.description: Demonstrates how to remove PDF bookmarks whose titles match a regular expression using the Aspose.Pdf.Facades bookmark editor. The example recursively traverses the bookmark tree and deletes matching entries.

collapse-specific-pdf-bookmarks.title: Collapse Specific PDF Bookmarks on Open
collapse-specific-pdf-bookmarks.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locating bookmarks by title, setting their Open property to false so they appear collapsed when the document is opened, and saving the updated file.

export-pdf-bookmarks-to-text.title: Export PDF Bookmarks to Text Outline
export-pdf-bookmarks-to-text.description: Demonstrates extracting PDF bookmarks with PdfBookmarkEditor and writing them to a plain‑text file, preserving hierarchy through indentation.

import-ofd-bookmarks-to-pdf.title: Import OFD Bookmarks into PDF
import-ofd-bookmarks-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load an OFD file, convert its outline hierarchy to PDF outline items, and add them to an existing PDF document.

add-javascript-bookmark-to-pdf.title: Create JavaScript Bookmarks in PDF
add-javascript-bookmark-to-pdf.description: Shows how to add outline bookmarks with JavaScript actions to an existing PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-delete-bookmarks-from-encrypted-pd.title: Batch Delete Bookmarks from Encrypted PDFs
batch-delete-bookmarks-from-encrypted-pd.description: Shows how to open password‑protected PDF files, bind them to a PdfBookmarkEditor, delete all existing bookmarks, and save the changes back to the original files in a batch operation.

rename-pdf-bookmarks-using-translation-d.title: Rename PDF Bookmarks Using a Translation Dictionary
rename-pdf-bookmarks-using-translation-d.description: Demonstrates how to rename PDF bookmarks based on a case‑insensitive translation dictionary using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfBookmarkEditor.

validate-pdf-bookmarks-against-toc.title: Validate PDF Bookmarks Against Generated Table of Contents
validate-pdf-bookmarks-against-toc.description: The example extracts PDF bookmarks using the Facades API, builds a simple table of contents from the first line of each page, compares the bookmark page numbers with the TOC entries, and writes a consistency report.

add-image-bookmarks-to-pdf.title: Add Image Bookmarks to PDF
add-image-bookmarks-to-pdf.description: The example loads a PDF, iterates through each page's image resources, and creates a top‑level bookmark that links directly to the image's location using an XYZ destination.

set-bookmark-zoom-level-150-percent.title: Update PDF Bookmark Zoom Level to 150% Using PdfBookmarkEditor
set-bookmark-zoom-level-150-percent.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfBookmarkEditor to extract, modify, and re‑add PDF bookmarks so that each bookmark opens the page at a 150% XYZ zoom, handling nested bookmarks recursively.

export-pdf-bookmarks-to-excel.title: Export PDF Bookmarks to CSV for Excel
export-pdf-bookmarks-to-excel.description: Demonstrates how to extract PDF bookmarks using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfBookmarkEditor and write them to a CSV file that can be opened in Excel, with title, level, and destination columns.

import-bookmarks-from-csv.title: Import Bookmarks from CSV into PDF
import-bookmarks-from-csv.description: Shows how to read a CSV file, parse each line into title, level, and destination, and add those bookmarks to an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfBookmarkEditor.

create-bookmark-to-named-destination.title: Create Bookmark to Named Destination
create-bookmark-to-named-destination.description: Shows how to add a top‑level bookmark that links to an existing named destination in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-duplicate-bookmarks.title: Remove Duplicate Bookmarks from PDF Outline
remove-duplicate-bookmarks.description: Demonstrates how to extract the outline (bookmarks) of a PDF, identify and remove entries that have identical titles and actions, and then rebuild the outline with only unique bookmarks.

batch-add-reviewed-bookmark-to-pdfs.title: Batch Add "Reviewed" Bookmark to PDF Files
batch-add-reviewed-bookmark-to-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a folder of PDFs, determine each document's last page, and append a "Reviewed" bookmark using Aspose.Pdf's bookmark editor.

add-colored-bookmarks-to-pdf.title: Color PDF Bookmarks Based on Title
add-colored-bookmarks-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, extract its bookmarks using the PdfBookmarkEditor facade, and set bookmark title colors (red for warnings, green for informational sections) before saving the document.

export-pdf-bookmarks-to-json.title: Export PDF Bookmark Hierarchy to JSON
export-pdf-bookmarks-to-json.description: Shows how to extract the bookmark tree from a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades, capture each node's title, level, and page number, and write the hierarchy to a JSON file.

import-bookmarks-from-database.title: Import Bookmarks from Database into PDF
import-bookmarks-from-database.description: Shows how to read bookmark records (simulated with a DataTable) and add them to an existing PDF using the PdfBookmarkEditor facade.

adjust-pdf-bookmarks-after-inserting-pag.title: Insert Blank Pages at Document Start and Update Bookmarks
adjust-pdf-bookmarks-after-inserting-pag.description: Demonstrates how to prepend blank pages to an existing PDF and then shift all bookmark destinations to keep them accurate using Aspose.Pdf.
